name: To Heart CR
source:
Choose one of six familiar ToHeart characters and enjoy two game modes. Lovely stand presents a simulation game while Quest mode contains conversations with favorite heroines.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
从六位熟悉的《ToHeart》角色中选一位，体验两种游戏模式。“Lovely Stand”是模拟游戏模式，“Quest”模式则可与喜爱的女主角们对话。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
